full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 13
Federal
Nepal
Daily Agenda
Parliament,
2083 Jestha 17, Sunday
1:00 PM
(Tentative)
Clause-by-clause discussion and approval of the report of the Rules Drafting Committee.
Honorable Chairperson Ganesh Parajuli of the House of Representatives Rules Drafting Committee will present the proposal to "Commence clause-by-clause discussion on the Report of the House of Representatives Rules Drafting Committee, 2083".
Proposed amendments to the said report will be presented for decision.
Honorable Chairperson Ganesh Parajuli of the House of Representatives Rules Drafting Committee will present the proposal to "Approve the Report of the House of Representatives Rules Drafting Committee, 2083".
Management Work
Honorable Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle:-
(a) Will present the proposal to seek permission to present the "Nepal Rastra Bank (Third Amendment) Bill, 2083".
(b) Will present the "Nepal Rastra Bank (Third Amendment) Bill, 2083".
Treaty-related Work
Honorable Minister for Youth, Employment and Labor Ramji Yadav:-
(a) Will present the "International Labour Organization's Labour Inspection Convention, 1947 (No. 81)".
(b) Will present the "Protocol of 2014 to the Forced Labour Convention, 1930, No. 29".
Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General
